review
ith good game but grind

Planes of memalodon
adds a fairly fun reputation grind. the rewards are not really worth it but the rewards you get throu rep are fun. The best thing is covering your ship with fish

Frost place
it is frosty, there are plushies, thats about it

Bald man bad
it adds a overly expensive roomba, bad update

Infested play pit
Best Rep grind to date, learned a lot from fortuna and the plains

Space Update
it involves Space n ♥♥♥♥, quite annoying to play with timers all the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ time.

Lord Of The Rings Shadow Of Mordor
very late game content, rewarding but also annoying as all hell.

A war that is new well also being old at the same time
fairly good quest

Spooky Ghosts
adds a terrible tower defense mode and a new rep grind. Dorms don't make sense, we already have the orbiter as a player house. Evolving weapons are kinda cool but i'm kinda feeling strange about all these late game weapon grinds that all have strange tack on's to make them powerful.

Clem V2
cool little side diversion. a good way to get rivens.

Horse Update
Didn't play it. Is avoidable. 

Gorge Orwell's 1984
Ok late game grind and a cool free book.

Pregnancy Update
This is getting people back into the game more than most other updates.

Gorge Orwells 1999
Long awaited continuation of the classic 1984 with a complete non-sense plot and a lot of things that barely make any sense. Playing This right after the pregnancy update really points to borderline delusion. (Future note: i have no clue what this is referencing)

Death Stranding 2
OwO UwU OwO (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻ (Crash) 20 people died. (Future note: i have no clue what this is referencing Either)

Horse Update
Horse Update is now nonnegotiable. Its neat. Kinda Jarring as its meant to give backstory to the drifter. The gameplay is fun. Still quite optional, It feels like a proper orokin open world filling out the roster.
Good game. Has good reward system. A bit repetative but decent overall.
